alinti: He was a merry person, given to jesting, to liquor, and to hunting elephants at Dalla near Rangoon.
kaynak: Harvey, History of Burma (1925), Kingdom of Pagan 1044-1287 bolumu (Uzana 1250-54, Dalla near Rangoon)
not: Yer adi Rangoon cumlede 1250-54 icin geciyor ama Dalla (Rangun civari) ve Pagan krali baglami; Rangun sehri degil bolge duzeyi. Harvey 1925: Pagan 1044-1287; Delta 1287'de Wareru ile kopar.

alinti: was founded in B.E. 641 (1279 A D.) by the Princes
kaynak: Scott & Hardiman, Gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States (1900-01), Pyinmana maddesi (Toungoo tarihcesi, yerel kaynak)
not: Gazetteer: kurulus 1279 (yerel gelenek). Phayre 1883 (historyofburmain00phay): 12. yy'da Pugan krali Narabadi'nin ziyareti anlatilir (efsanevi). Harvey kronoloji tablosunda 'Foundation of Toungoo' 1277-1281 arasi satirda (yil eslesmesi sutun kaymasiyla belirsiz). CELISKI notu: Wood s.53 listesinde Taungu Ramkamheng'e tabi sayilir (tarihi belirsiz).

alinti: Raheng, Mesot, Tenasserim, Tavoy, Martaban, Taungu, Pegu right up to the Bay of Bengal
kaynak: Wood, A History of Siam (1926), ch. III s.53-54
not: Wood listesi 'When he died' (Ramkamheng ~1275-1317 saltanati sonu) icin; 1280-01-01 ani DEGIL, tarih belirsiz. Harvey: Pagan Tenasserim'de hukmetti (Mergui yazitii) ama Tavoy adi anilmaz. Sahip Pagan mi Sukhothai mi belirsiz.

alinti: set up in Mergui by one of the Pagan kings shows that the dynasty ruled there
kaynak: Harvey, History of Burma (1925), Kingdom of Pagan 1044-1287 bolumu (Alaungsithu 1112-67 Tenasserim seferi)
not: Mergui adi Pagan'in Alaungsithu doneminde (1112-67) gecer; 1280 durumu dogrudan degil. Wood: Tenasserim Ramkamheng'e tabi (1280 tarihsiz) -> CELISKI riski.

alinti: in 1096 arrived at Patheio (Bassein) where he left some of his queens
kaynak: Scott & Hardiman, Gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States (1900-01), Pagan hanedani maddesi (Kyanzittha/Alaungsithu 1096)
not: Harvey: Alaungsithu 1112-67 'quelling rebellion in places such as Bassein'. Phayre: Narathihapate 1283'te Bassein'e kacti (Pagan alani). Pagan 1280'de sahibi.

alinti: the Irrawaddy valley from Bhamo to the sea, the nearer Shans on both sides, north Arakan, and north Tenasserim
kaynak: Harvey, History of Burma (1925), Kingdom of Pagan 1044-1287 bolumu (Anawrahta 1044-77 overlordship)
not: Bolge duzeyi: Anawrahta donemi hakimiyet siniri 'Bhamo'dan denize'. Mogol Mien seferleri 1277-87 (Harvey/Yule) Bhamo yoresini etkiler; 1280 durumu belirsiz.
<=1280 cumle yok. Harvey Taungdwingyi'yi ancak 14. yy isyanlari baglaminda anar.

alinti: Myingyan, Kyaukse, Yamethin, Magwe, Sagaing and Katha east of the Irrawaddy, and the riverine portions of Pakokku and Minbu

not: Myingyan DISTRICT adi (Anawrahta 1044-77 cekirdek bolgesi); kasaba degil. Harvey: Tuywin/Lawkananda pagodalari Myingyan district'te.

alinti: the present districts of Mandalay, Meiktila, Myingyan, Kyaukse, Yamethin, Magwe

alinti: that the Chaghan-jang were found in the vicinity of Likiangfu

alinti: Nantien, Muang Maing, Kiang Hung, Kiang Tung, and Theinni, besides other smaller States, became prin- cipalities of the Mau empire

not: Colquhoun/Lacouperie: 1229 'Mau empire' prensipligi (Kiang Tung adi var). Wood s.54: Kengtung (then K'emarat) Lannat'ai'ye dahil (1275-98 baglami). Iki sahip: Mau/Shan vs Lan Na. Kaynak zayif (1885, hakemsiz).

alinti: the name had been changed from Kamarupa to Kamata
kaynak: Gait, A History of Assam (1906), Events of XIII-XV centuries
not: Gait: 13. yy'da Karatoya'ya kadar Kamarupa/Kamata krallik; Tughril Han 'about 1278' istila; Ahomlar Gauhati'yi 1667'de aldi (1679'da kaybetti). Atlas ahom 1281 penceresi Gait ile celisir; 1280 sahibi Kamata (atlas kunyesi yok).
Gait: Sibsagar/Rangpur sehri 1253'te yok; Sukapha Simaluguri'de (1246-53), Charaideo'ya tasindi. <=1280 Sibsagar cumlesi yok.

alinti: In 12538 Simaluguri was abandoned in favour of Charaideo, where a city was built amid general rejoicings.
kaynak: Gait, A History of Assam (1906), Rise of the Ahom Kingdom (Sukapha 1228-1268)
not: OCR '12538' = 1253 + dipnot 8; kronoloji 1228 (Sukapha), 1244, 1246 Simaluguri, sonra Charaideo. Gun kaynakta yok.

alinti: Phre, Nan, Luang P'rabang, P'itsanulok, Lomsak, Wiengchan
